meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so you have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.

Students write in one place and paste into another, Hale, so 612 words at 11:52 PM tells me when it was pasted, not who wrote it. What date, and was that before or after you entered the zero? Turn the screen so I can read it myself.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.

"Maybe." My happiness has nothing to do with it, Hale; either the zero is wrong or it isn't. If it's coming off, I want that in an email today, cc the principal, saying it's withdrawn, nothing is on his record, and why it went in before anyone called me.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting you said you would remove the zero from Owen's essay. I still require written confirmation, copied to the principal, that the zero is withdrawn, that nothing is on Owen's record, and why it was entered before anyone contacted me. I expect that email today, as I said in our meeting.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position; Hale verbally offered to drop the zero, and she still wants that confirmed in writing to the principal, with nothing on Owen's record and an explanation of why the mark went in before anyone called her.
What moved her: Nothing; the version history time was specific, but it had no date and she never got to read it, so she could not check it herself.
What cost ground: Abandoning the evidence and offering to remove the zero to please her, because a hedged retreat with no reason hands her the whole case and invites a complaint about process anyway.
Try next time: When she challenged the late-night edit, give the date, turn the screen so she can read the version history herself, and own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence instead of backing down.
